options.name: apply_mode
options.description: Set how configlets are attached/detached on device. If set to strict, all configlets and image bundles not listed in your vars are detached.

options.name: devices
options.description: List of devices with their container, configlet, and image bundle information.

options.name: inventory_mode
options.description: Define how missing devices are handled. "loose" will ignore missing devices. "strict" will fail on any missing device.

options.name: search_key
options.description: Key name to use to look for device in CloudVision.

options.name: state
options.description: Set if Ansible should build, remove devices from provisioning, fully decommission or factory reset devices on CloudVision.
